berth

╭─────────────────────────────────────╮
│ berth restart acme                  │
│                                     │
│ This recreates the container.       │
│ It stops the work running in acme.  │
│                                     │
│ Run it? y = yes, anything else = no │
╰─────────────────────────────────────╯













y run it · any other key cancels
